evidence.description: The class stores a dictionary of tasks as an instance property.
A new Task is created and stored in the activeTasks dictionary, which strongly captures 'self' (the Images instance).
The captured 'self' is used within the long-running Task, creating a retain cycle as the task is stored in the dictionary of the object it captures.

candidates.explanation: The class 'Images' stores a reference to a Task in its `activeTasks` dictionary. This Task strongly captures 'self' (the 'Images' instance) to call `self.send(item)` and update its own properties. Because the Task is stored as a property of 'Images', this creates a strong reference cycle where the object and the task retain each other, preventing deallocation.
candidates.title: Task Ownership Retain Cycle
